text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During training leading up to the Japan 
Cup, Cheval Grand casually chats about the 
race with Satono Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having achieved extraordinary growth, 
Kitasan Black was held in high regard. As 
all eyes turned toward her, Cheval Grand 
calmly analyzed her running style.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her strength comes from respecting others 
and facing them head-on—Satono Crown 
murmurs that the hardest one to read right 
now is Cheval Grand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the real race had arrived. 
Cheval Grand reaffirmed to Shine Praise 
that she would become a "great Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Formidable, undeniable rivals, and the 
daring, valiant Umamusume who transformed 
into era-defining monsters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand pushed through the fray and 
proudly proclaimed victory before the 
spectators.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—Courage, carrying across the sea. At 
last, the Japan Cup gets underway.
